results.question: Where do I put the .frlicense file on a Mac?
results.answer: Put the `.frlicense` file in `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/` on a Mac. If the folder is missing, create it. To access this location, in Finder choose **Go > Go to Folder** (Cmd-Shift-G) and paste the path.

results.question: I pasted my license but it still says unlicensed
results.answer:
* Reload the session by closing and reopening it, or by removing and re-adding the plugin.
* Check that the license line matches the plugin you have open.
* Ensure you copied the entire license line from the email, from start to end, with nothing added.
* Use the `.frlicense` file instead of pasting the line.

If none of that works, write to us through the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: Do I need to be online for the plugins to work?
results.answer: No, you do not need to be online. The plugins contain no license check over the network, and your license is verified offline on your machine. There is no server that has to be running for your session to open.

results.question: What happens when the demo ends?
results.answer: The plugin keeps loading and passing audio, but includes a brief silence every so often to mark that it is unlicensed. This is a brief (~1 s) faded silence every ~45 s. The plugin never mutes a track outright and never in the first 30 seconds of playback. A bar on the panel says what is happening and what to do.

results.question: I already own two plugins, can I get the rest at the bundle price?
results.answer:
Yes. On the [pricing page](https://fruitlessresearch.com/pricing/), under **Already own some of these?**, enter the email you bought with. You will get a link that prices the bundle with what you already own taken off at the bundle's own rate—you pay 27% under list for the plugins you do not have yet. The exact amount is shown at checkout.

results.question: Why was tax added at checkout?
results.answer: Prices are shown before tax. Your local sales tax, VAT or GST is added at checkout and shown in full before you pay. Our payment provider (Paddle) is the merchant of record and handles the tax; its name is what appears on your card statement.

results.answer:

* To request a refund, use the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).
